S0.xyz and X.xyz each contain one structure of formula C4H8N2S1 (angstrom). X has been rigidly rotated and translated, and its atom order may differ from S0. Treat structures that interconvert only by rotation about single bonds as the same compound. Which describes X relative to S0?

选项：
A. the same compound as S0 (only conformation and/or orientation differ)
B. an enantiomer of S0 (its non-superimposable mirror image)
C. a diastereomer of S0 (a stereoisomer that is not its mirror image)
D. a constitutional isomer of S0 (same formula, different bonding)

附件：S0.xyz、X.xyz（均为本题完整输入）。范围：QM7-X 分子 7029 同一立体异构体的两个构象。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
